card.title: More Committed Than You
card.instruction: Treat belief in the scene’s strangest premise as a contest, proving your commitment through increasingly unnecessary demonstrations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You signed the pledge that the moon hears us? I'll sign with both hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One signature's enough. I'm taking it outside tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll use two pens. She should know which of us means it twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's illegible. She won't know your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write it across my bedsheet. You can carry your little page.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 doubles the pledge signature, A3 uses two pens to mean it twice, and A5 answers illegibility with a vastly larger display that belittles B's page.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's one-signature and outdoor plan cause A3's double-pen commitment; B4's unreadable-name objection causes A5's bedsheet signature.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a practical plan to carry the pledge outside and B4 identifies a real problem with A's demonstration.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's readability objection to escalate visible devotion rather than simplify the original act.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a pledge to a listening moon and B2 its nighttime presentation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's little-page comparison is earned by B4's criticism and the expanded writing surface.

coach2.situation: A1 establishes a pledge to a listening moon and B2 its nighttime presentation.
coach2.stated: A3's two-handed writing explains B4's illegibility; A5 proposes a larger surface rather than claiming the existing name is readable.
coach2.inferred: A1-B4 establish participants in the same moon-directed belief ritual.
coach2.missing: No essential gap; whether the moon actually reads is part of their premise, not a fact needed outside it.
coach2.firstDefect: No mandatory defect; each correction prompts another excessive competitive demonstration.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 says A1's extra signature is unnecessary and explains the delivery plan.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 turns B2's standard into a two-pen proof of greater commitment.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 identifies the illegible result of A3's method.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 increases the display size in response to B4 while diminishing B's offering.
